text:
rebecca: Deploybot fired an auto-revert recommendation for staged rollout v4.0.1. It hit error_rate threshold during embeddings smoke in us-west. autopilot suggests `--auto-revert` but change window still open for 25m. Thoughts? :warning:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Embeddings service: error_rate=1.6% (threshold 1.0%), latency_p95=1800ms (threshold 1200ms). Action: recommend auto-revert to v4.0.0. To approve: `/deploy revert --auto v4.0.0`
josh: i'm seeing increased tail latency on dedicated pools. looks like new quantization path plus a routing config caused retry storms. If we auto-revert we avoid more customer impact but we'll lose an opportunity to capture logs for postmortem.
anita: +1 to manual rollback. we should snapshot the canary and collect flamegraphs first. also need legal loop if commit touches model licensing binary (it does). cc @legal
legal: saw the commit. there's a 3rd-party quant lib change, we need to confirm SCA results before redeploy. approve manual for now — keep customers informed.
rebecca: proposed plan: 1) block auto-revert (ops-run can flip safety latch) 2) take snapshots & run `pgrep`+perf on canary nodes 3) pin routing to v4.0.0 for 1h 4) route 0%->20% test -> 100% if stable, else full revert. josh, anita, can you own steps 2 & 3?
josh: yes — i'll run perf snapshot and hold autoscaler. command i'll run: `./tools/collector snapshot --target canary --out /tmp/snap-5790055000.tar.gz`
ops-run: flipping auto-revert safety latch to manual mode now. revert-on-threshold suspended at 5790055012. Will not execute auto actions until explicit `/deploy revert` from a lead.
anita: collecting flamegraphs and SCA double-check. `docker exec -it collector sh -c "perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30"`
sales-eng: flagging a seat customer who was in beta for v4.0.1 — i'll preemptively DM them and share a short note if we do manual rollback.
rebecca: good. also update release-notes: add entry "rolled back staging to v4.0.0 due to embedding latency; investigating quant path" if we go full revert. keep the draft link ready.
josh: snapshots uploaded: gs://redwood-dumps/snap-5790055000.tar.gz. initial flamegraphs show user-space spin in quant kernel.
anita: SCA is clean for licensing but flagged performance regression in the new lib. will open ticket on research/repro and tag model-ops.
ops-run: routing pin applied (lock id lock-44b). pinned to v4.0.0 for 1h.
rebecca: decision: proceed manual unwind. timeline: 10m monitoring at 20% slice, if p95 < 1300ms and error_rate < 0.5% proceed to 100% then unpin. if not, run `/deploy revert --manual v4.0.0` and notify customers. anita, josh, publish logs + artifact locations here when ready.
josh: metrics at 20% slice: p95=1150ms, error_rate=0.3%. looks stable.
anita: artifacts: perf + flamegraph links: https://artifacts.redwood/snap-5790055000/flame.html and SCA report https://sca.redwood/reports/5790055000.html
legal: okay to proceed with manual given SCA clean. keep me in the loop for final communication.
sales-eng: customer DM sent. no immediate complaints.
rebecca: proceeding to 100% now. ops-run — remove pin and finalize cutover when traffic stable.
ops-run: removing pin and shifting to v4.0.0 100% at 5790055026. cutover complete, traffic at 100% and autoscaler re-enabled.
josh: post-cutover checks pass. p95=900ms, error_rate=0.05%. closing loop: will open postmortem ticket with logs and perf artifacts, and coordinate release follow-up with research.
rebecca: thanks everyone. i'll publish the short customer note and update release notes. marking thread for postmortem tracking id PM-5790055. :white_check_mark:
